# We are Adient.

A global leader in automotive seating.
* [Products][18]
* [Approaches][19]
* [Advancements][20]

[Superior results through state-of-the-art seating products]

## Superior results through state-of-the-art seating products

At Adient, our reputation as a global leader in automotive seating begins with our products – from
complete seating systems to individual components – and extends across our entire portfolio. Our
deep expertise means that our products always stand out and apart in craftsmanship, comfort, style
and safety.

[Learn more about our products][21]

[Expertise. Experience. Excellence.]

## Expertise. Experience. Excellence.

At Adient, operational excellence goes beyond manufacturing. Every day, our teams around the world
work tirelessly to improve their performance. Enhance their efficiency. And execute flawlessly.
Every time.

[Learn more about our capabilities][22]

[Adapting. Advancing. Always moving forward.]

## Adapting. Advancing. Always moving forward.

At Adient, we’re at the forefront of industry trends and technologies. Every day, we challenge
ourselves to make our products and processes better – and to improve the experience of a world in
motion.

[Learn more about our technology and innovations][23]

### One patent filed nearly

every day

### ~200 locations worldwide

anywhere in the world

[Right where you need us to be]

### Right where you need us to be

For more than 30 years we’ve delivered precisely what our global consumers demand – on time, just in
time, every time.

### Empowering our people

## Le développement durable : notre engagement fondamental

### Prendre soin des personnes et de la planète

Nous nous engageons à façonner un avenir plus durable et plus inclusif en plaçant la responsabilité
au cœur de toutes nos actions. Qu'il s'agisse de promouvoir une culture diversifiée et inclusive qui
stimule l'innovation ou de faire progresser notre feuille de route vers la neutralité carbone d'ici
2045, nous agissons avec ambition et responsabilité. Dans l'ensemble de nos activités, nous
respectons les normes éthiques les plus strictes, en encourageant l'intégrité et des pratiques
commerciales responsables à l'échelle mondiale.

### Construisons un avenir plus durable chez FORVIA

The FORVIA Foundation’s 2025–2026 Activity Report is out!

One ambition: to keep empowering employees to “be useful where it matters the most” in support to
the communities wherever we operate.

This employee-led approach remains the Foundation’s greatest strength.
Every project starts with the commitment, ideas and expertise of FORVIANS who turn local challenges
into meaningful action.

In 2026, this ambition reached a new milestone with the launch of FORVIA Solidarity Day, which
mobilized more than 16,000 employees across 24 countries.

This activity report shows what happens when thousands of employees choose to make a difference.

This is where a big share of North America’s in-car electronics is built.

Displays, infotainment systems, cameras… all produced for key automakers right here in San Juan del
Río!

The plant combines lean principles and digital tools through the FORVIA Excellence System, serving
as a role model for operational excellence.

Quality is built in through prevention, with the 8 Quality Basics and full traceability.

Daily performance is driven on the ground:
Top 5 meetings, shopfloor tours and KPI-based reviews keep teams aligned. Visual management boards
reinforce HSE, quality and FORVIA Excellence System culture, while regular town halls and leadership
interactions strengthen cross-shift communication.

China’s automotive industry is entering a new phase of decarbonization.

For years, the discussion was mostly about long-term targets.
Today, the focus is shifting to something much more concrete.

In China, it’s already visible across the automotive value chain.
Regulations are moving from energy control to carbon control.
OEMs are asking more questions about ESG performance, renewable energy, product carbon footprint and
supply chain emissions.

Carbon performance is becoming a factor of competitiveness.

At FORVIA China, this transition is already happening on the factory floor.
Decarbonization becomes part of daily operations: energy management systems, plant-level
specialists, local roadmaps and teams trained to turn targets into action.

In a market as fast-moving as China, execution is what will make the difference.

## Le développement durable : notre engagement fondamental

### Prendre soin des personnes et de la planète

Nous nous engageons à façonner un avenir plus durable et plus inclusif en plaçant la responsabilité
au cœur de toutes nos actions. Qu'il s'agisse de promouvoir une culture diversifiée et inclusive qui
stimule l'innovation ou de faire progresser notre feuille de route vers la neutralité carbone d'ici
2045, nous agissons avec ambition et responsabilité. Dans l'ensemble de nos activités, nous
respectons les normes éthiques les plus strictes, en encourageant l'intégrité et des pratiques
commerciales responsables à l'échelle mondiale.

China’s automotive industry is entering a new phase of decarbonization.

For years, the discussion was mostly about long-term targets.
Today, the focus is shifting to something much more concrete.

In China, it’s already visible across the automotive value chain.
Regulations are moving from energy control to carbon control.
OEMs are asking more questions about ESG performance, renewable energy, product carbon footprint and
supply chain emissions.

Carbon performance is becoming a factor of competitiveness.

At FORVIA China, this transition is already happening on the factory floor.
Decarbonization becomes part of daily operations: energy management systems, plant-level
specialists, local roadmaps and teams trained to turn targets into action.

In a market as fast-moving as China, execution is what will make the difference.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# Tarkett Flooring for Commercial and Residential spaces

Tarkett is a world leader in innovative commercial flooring and sports surface solutions that meet
design and functional requirements in multiple market segments: [Healthcare][165], [Aged
Care,][166] the [Workplace][167], [Education][168], [Stores and Shops][169], [Hospitality and
Leisure][170], [Residential][171] and [Sports ][172]segments. Tarkett offers an extensive range of
commercial flooring products including [Homogeneous][173] & [Heterogeneous][174] vinyl
rolls, [luxury vinyl
tiles,][175] [linoleum][176][,][177] [carpet][178], [wood][179] and[ laminate.][180] Committed to
making a positive impact on people and the planet, Tarkett is present in more than 100 countries,
creating people friendly living spaces worldwide that combine well-being, health, performance and
design.

## Stephan Adler

Geschäftsführer Finanzen

 

Stephan Adler verfügt über mehr als 20-jährige kaufmännische Führungserfahrung in internationalen
Unternehmen in den Branchen der Automobilzulieferung, Pyrotechnik und Verpackungstechnik. Nachdem er
verschiedene kaufmännische Positionen für Magna International in Europa ausübte, war er zuletzt als
CFO der NBHX Trim Group in Bruchsal tätig. Seit 2020 hat er die Position als CFO für die AIS Group
übernommen. Intern wie extern wird Stephan Adler für seine große Erfahrung im kaufmännischen Bereich
und in der Automobilzulieferindustrie geschätzt.

✕ Schließen

## Dr. Klaus-Jürgen Kurr

Vorsitzender der Geschäftsführung

 

Dr. Klaus-Jürgen Kurr hat sein gesamtes Berufsleben in der Automobilzulieferindustrie verbracht.
Nach der Promotion im Studienfach Maschinenbau an der TU Darmstadt zeichnete er sich für den Aufbau
Geschäftsbereichs Cockpitsysteme in der Siemens VDO verantwortlich. Als Geschäftsführer führte er
den Bereich zu einer Umsatzgröße von mehr als einer Milliarden Euro innerhalb weniger Jahre.  

Im Jahr 2001 gründete er die heutige AIS-Gruppe. Seitdem hat er diese zu einem weltweit agierenden
Automobilzulieferanten entwickelt. 

✕ Schließen

## Sven Ritzke

Geschäftsführer Vertrieb

 

Sven Ritzke verfügt über profunde Kenntnisse im Vertriebs- und Kundenmanagement in der
Automobilzulieferindustrie und hat diese in seiner über 20-jährigen Unternehmenszugehörigkeit bei
der Woco-Gruppe in verschiedenen Funktionen und Positionen unter Beweis gestellt. Zuletzt war er in
der Woco-Gruppe als Vice President Global Sales tätig und verantwortete deren weltweiten
Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Im Jahr 2022 trat Herr Ritzke in die Unternehmensgruppe ein und übernahm in der Geschäftsführung der
AIS Group die Verantwortung für den Bereich Vertrieb.

✕ Schließen

## Stephan Adler

Geschäftsführer Finanzen

 

Stephan Adler verfügt über mehr als 20-jährige kaufmännische Führungserfahrung in internationalen
Unternehmen in den Branchen der Automobilzulieferung, Pyrotechnik und Verpackungstechnik. Nachdem er
verschiedene kaufmännische Positionen für Magna International in Europa ausübte, war er zuletzt als
CFO der NBHX Trim Group in Bruchsal tätig. Seit 2020 hat er die Position als CFO für die AIS Group
übernommen. Intern wie extern wird Stephan Adler für seine große Erfahrung im kaufmännischen Bereich
und in der Automobilzulieferindustrie geschätzt.

✕ Schließen

## Dr. Klaus-Jürgen Kurr

Vorsitzender der Geschäftsführung

 

Dr. Klaus-Jürgen Kurr hat sein gesamtes Berufsleben in der Automobilzulieferindustrie verbracht.
Nach der Promotion im Studienfach Maschinenbau an der TU Darmstadt zeichnete er sich für den Aufbau
Geschäftsbereichs Cockpitsysteme in der Siemens VDO verantwortlich. Als Geschäftsführer führte er
den Bereich zu einer Umsatzgröße von mehr als einer Milliarden Euro innerhalb weniger Jahre.  

Im Jahr 2001 gründete er die heutige AIS-Gruppe. Seitdem hat er diese zu einem weltweit agierenden
Automobilzulieferanten entwickelt. 

✕ Schließen

## Sven Ritzke

Geschäftsführer Vertrieb

 

Sven Ritzke verfügt über profunde Kenntnisse im Vertriebs- und Kundenmanagement in der
Automobilzulieferindustrie und hat diese in seiner über 20-jährigen Unternehmenszugehörigkeit bei
der Woco-Gruppe in verschiedenen Funktionen und Positionen unter Beweis gestellt. Zuletzt war er in
der Woco-Gruppe als Vice President Global Sales tätig und verantwortete deren weltweiten
Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Im Jahr 2022 trat Herr Ritzke in die Unternehmensgruppe ein und übernahm in der Geschäftsführung der
AIS Group die Verantwortung für den Bereich Vertrieb.

✕ Schließen

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

As the automotive industry looks for more sustainable options, plastic remains the material of
choice for many surface films in interiors. But with growing environmental awareness, could this
trend be changing? In this article, we’ll compare silicone decorative films with plastic decorative
films and explore why silicone is emerging as a strong contender for the future of automotive
interiors.

### [What is Marine Fabric: Uses, Benefits, and How to Choose][46]

Marine fabric is a durable textile designed to endure harsh marine environments. Typically made from
synthetic fibers like acrylic, polyester, or vinyl, it resists water, UV rays, salt, mold, and
mildew. With added waterproof coatings and treatments, it ensures long-lasting weather resistance
and breathability, keeping boat interiors and exteriors dry.

### [What is HMI? Understanding Human-Machine Interfaces & Their Uses][47]

A Human-Machine Interface (HMI) is a technology that facilitates communication between humans and
machines through an interface, typically a graphical user interface on devices like touch screens,
keyboards, or voice commands to process inputs.

[ [An infographic to show the layers of a membrane keyboard, including graphic overlay, spacer, dome
retainer, circuit layer, and mouting adhesive.] ][49]
A membrane keypad is a type of keyboard or input device that uses a flexible membrane layer with
conductive traces to register keystrokes. When a key is pressed, the top membrane layer flexes and
pushes down on the holes layer, making contact with the conductive traces on the bottom layer.

production of membrane keypads. GS introduces enhanced design flexibility, improved durability, and
superior hygiene into keypad manufacturing by integrating this sophisticated silicone film with
in-mold decoration processes. Demonstrating the practicality and effectiveness of Compo-SiL®
silicone technology, GS has developed reference prototypes to aid manufacturers and brands in
evaluating the benefits silicone surfaces can bring to their keypad product lines.

### [What Keeps Plastic as the Dominant Material in Automotive Interior Films?][45]

As the automotive industry looks for more sustainable options, plastic remains the material of
choice for many surface films in interiors. But with growing environmental awareness, could this
trend be changing? In this article, we’ll compare silicone decorative films with plastic decorative
films and explore why silicone is emerging as a strong contender for the future of automotive
interiors.

### [What is Marine Fabric: Uses, Benefits, and How to Choose][46]

Marine fabric is a durable textile designed to endure harsh marine environments. Typically made from
synthetic fibers like acrylic, polyester, or vinyl, it resists water, UV rays, salt, mold, and
mildew. With added waterproof coatings and treatments, it ensures long-lasting weather resistance
and breathability, keeping boat interiors and exteriors dry.

### [What is HMI? Understanding Human-Machine Interfaces & Their Uses][47]

A Human-Machine Interface (HMI) is a technology that facilitates communication between humans and
machines through an interface, typically a graphical user interface on devices like touch screens,
keyboards, or voice commands to process inputs.

### [Membrane Keypad Explained: How They Work & Their Uses][48]

[ [An infographic to show the layers of a membrane keyboard, including graphic overlay, spacer, dome
retainer, circuit layer, and mouting adhesive.] ][49]
A membrane keypad is a type of keyboard or input device that uses a flexible membrane layer with
conductive traces to register keystrokes. When a key is pressed, the top membrane layer flexes and
pushes down on the holes layer, making contact with the conductive traces on the bottom layer.

### [Membrane Keypad Manufacturing Transformed with Compo-SiL® Decorative Film][50]

[ [Membrane Keypad Manufacturing Transformed with Compo-SiL® Decorative Film] ][51]
Hsinchu, Taiwan, July, 02, 2024 – General Silicones Co., Ltd. (GS), renowned for its comprehensive
silicone solutions, announces an innovative application of its Compo-SiL® decorative film in the
production of membrane keypads. GS introduces enhanced design flexibility, improved durability, and
superior hygiene into keypad manufacturing by integrating this sophisticated silicone film with
in-mold decoration processes. Demonstrating the practicality and effectiveness of Compo-SiL®
silicone technology, GS has developed reference prototypes to aid manufacturers and brands in
evaluating the benefits silicone surfaces can bring to their keypad product lines.

### [How In-Mold Decoration Works: Process, Benefits, and Examples][52]

In-Mold Decoration (IMD) is a specialized surface decoration technology designed for plastic
injection molding. The process involves pre-printing patterns onto a film, which is then placed into
the injection mold. During molding, the film's pattern is transferred and bonded to the final
product.

# Exquisite
# Interiors

World class manufacturing combined with only the best materials produces the most amazing automotive
interiors. Let us show you how. Learn More Contact Us Contact Us Learn More Innovation Precision
Inside At CpK, precision runs much deeper than the detailed surface of our cast skin products. Learn
More Contact Us
[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Efficient Design

CpK moulding, assembly and sequencing experts can add significant value to your next automotive
interior. We excel at collaborating, coordinating, innovating and delivering flawless results.

[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Performance
### Starts Here

True quality begins with impeccable materials. Extensive R&D has resulted in the ability to exceed
the automotive industries most stringent performance challenges.

[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### A Team Of
### Professionals.

CpK employees are energized to deliver results for our customers.  It is our mission that leads us
to achieve heightened levels of performance in *process, accuracy* and customer *service*.

## Our Capabilities

Precision is Everything
[instron]

### Innovation

At CpK, extensive R&D has resulted in blends so refined they are proven to exceed the automotive
industries most stringent performance challenges.

 

[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Material Compounding

CpK’s proprietary grinding technology produces exacting tolerances to match the requirements of your
specific process.




[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Design For Manufacturing

CpK moulding, assembly and sequencing experts can add significant value to your next interior.




[Injection manufacturing]

### Injection Moulding

Vertical integration is a mainstay at CpK and in-house injection moulding of Class A interior
products, structural components and large complex modules is a core competency.

[Cast-Skin Manufacturing]

### Cast Skin and Foam

At CpK, cast skin and foam products provide a premium look and exceptionally soft feel. We are an
award winning door and instrument panel manufacturer.
 

[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Assembly

Precise assembly depends on exacting attention to every detail, especially with hundreds of module
variations passing through a single assembly operation.


[Cart Parts manufacturer]

### Sequencing

At CpK, we have sequencing down to an art form. Our sequencing extends far beyond our own modules
and parts

[Cart Parts manufacturer]
Our Little Story

### Precision is Everything

At CpK, precision runs much deeper than the detailed surface of our cast skin automotive interior
products. Providing expertise at every phase of our world-class automotive parts manufacturing
process, and with the deepest bench of manufacturing and product experts in the industry, we deliver
award winning craftsmanship synchronized with your vehicle goals.

The CpK advantage starts with our proprietary compounding of performance materials, where process
innovation blends with plastics engineering to deliver unsurpassed efficiency and optimum
performance in every automotive part we create. Shape the future with our proficiency in mould
tuning and design plus always receive the latest technology in graining, material haptics and
colour.

We’re here for you whether you require assistance in design for [automotive part manufacturing][38],
materials processing, tooling, moulding, assembly, sequencing, delivery, logistics, or the
orchestration of any or all of these. Our fine-tuned capabilities allow infinite combinations to
meet the unique specifications of the Original Equipment Manufacturers and Tier One automotive
interior suppliers, seamlessly and successfully. At CpK we strive to be the leading interior
automotive supplier in North America.

# Charakterstark: Lösungen für Premium-Fahrzeuge

Wir denken in Generationen. Mit diesem Selbstverständnis gestalten wir den Charakter der Mobilität
von morgen.

## Jede Zeit hat ihre Pioniere.

Unsere Geschichte ist die eines lokalen Familienunternehmens, aus dem eine globale
Unternehmensfamilie erwachsen ist.

> 60

##### Standorte

## WE CREATE CHARACTER

Trotz vieler Veränderungen ist das Entscheidende geblieben: unsere Unabhängigkeit, unsere
Kundenorientierung, der Zusammenhalt unserer Mitarbeitenden, unsere Produkte und unsere Passion für
Innovationen und die Gestaltung unserer Zukunft.

[ Über das Unternehmen ][98]
[Graue Türinnenseite eines BMW i3.] [Detaillierte Nahaufahme eines Kabelbaums.]

## Creating synergies for the world´s best brands

01 Interior Systems 02 Electrical Systems 03 E-Mobility Systems

Architekten des automobilen Innenraums: Die Zukunft der Mobilität ist nachhaltig und individuell.
Sie weist weit über die Transportfunktion hinaus und rückt die Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie deren
Erwartung an Mobilität und das Mobilitätserlebnis in den Mittelpunkt. Die Architektur der
Fahrzeuggestaltung ist so anspruchsvoll wie stilbildend. Im Fahrzeuginnenraum sind dabei der
Kreativität keine Grenzen gesetzt. Unsere Erfahrung macht uns zum kompetenten Spezialisten für
Premium-Oberflächen, innovative Produkte und Lichtszenarien.

[ Mehr erfahren ][99]

Es gibt kaum eine Fahrzeugfunktion, die nicht mit dem Bordnetz in Verbindung steht oder die über das
Bordnetz mit Strom oder Daten versorgt wird. Verteilen, absichern, kontaktieren: Diese drei Bereiche
müssen harmonisch und selbstverständlich zusammenarbeiten, wie in einem Nervensystem. Dabei ist
jedes Bordnetz anders und setzt eigene Maßstäbe. Bei bis zu 2.200 Leitungen in einem Fahrzeug und
einer kundenindividuellen Ausstattungs-Wahl ergeben sich bis zu 10³¹ Leitungssatzvarianten.

[ Mehr erfahren ][100]

Wir entwickeln, fertigen und liefern komplette, fahrzeugspezifische Bordnetze inklusive aller
elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf das präzise
Auslegen der Systeme für alle Spannungslagen – vom Verteilen über das Absichern bis hin zum
Kontaktieren. Unsere Lösungen funktionieren wie ein fein abgestimmtes Nervensystem im Fahrzeug.
Ergänzend dazu bieten wir leistungsstarke, zellunabhängige Batteriesysteme von 48 bis 800 Volt, die
durch das Zusammenspiel hochdichter Zellmodule, effizienter Kühlung und intelligenter
Zellüberwachung maximale Leistung und Reichweite ermöglichen. So setzen wir Maßstäbe für eine
nachhaltige, leistungsorientierte E-Mobilität.

[ Mehr erfahren ][101]

## Erfolg ist eine Charakterfrage.
## Bist du bereit?

Wir glauben daran, dass dein Charakter mindestens genauso viel zählt wie dein Abschluss. Wir wollen
dich nicht in einen genormten Karrieretunnel zwängen – sondern deinem Charakter die Bühne bereiten
und dir maßgeschneiderte Chancen bieten, um in deiner Einzigartigkeit zur Geltung zu kommen.

müssen harmonisch und selbstverständlich zusammenarbeiten, wie in einem Nervensystem. Dabei ist
jedes Bordnetz anders und setzt eigene Maßstäbe. Bei bis zu 2.200 Leitungen in einem Fahrzeug und
einer kundenindividuellen Ausstattungs-Wahl ergeben sich bis zu 10³¹ Leitungssatzvarianten.

[ Mehr erfahren ][100]

Wir entwickeln, fertigen und liefern komplette, fahrzeugspezifische Bordnetze inklusive aller
elektrischen und elektronischen Komponenten. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf das präzise
Auslegen der Systeme für alle Spannungslagen – vom Verteilen über das Absichern bis hin zum
Kontaktieren. Unsere Lösungen funktionieren wie ein fein abgestimmtes Nervensystem im Fahrzeug.
Ergänzend dazu bieten wir leistungsstarke, zellunabhängige Batteriesysteme von 48 bis 800 Volt, die
durch das Zusammenspiel hochdichter Zellmodule, effizienter Kühlung und intelligenter
Zellüberwachung maximale Leistung und Reichweite ermöglichen. So setzen wir Maßstäbe für eine
nachhaltige, leistungsorientierte E-Mobilität.

[ Mehr erfahren ][101]

## Erfolg ist eine Charakterfrage.
## Bist du bereit?

Wir glauben daran, dass dein Charakter mindestens genauso viel zählt wie dein Abschluss. Wir wollen
dich nicht in einen genormten Karrieretunnel zwängen – sondern deinem Charakter die Bühne bereiten
und dir maßgeschneiderte Chancen bieten, um in deiner Einzigartigkeit zur Geltung zu kommen.

[ Zu Karriere & Jobs ][102]

Wir denken in Generationen. Das ist es, was unser Familienunternehmen seit jeher ausmacht.

[Ein E-Fahrzeug ist an einer E-Ladesäule angeschlossen. ]

Wir gehören zu den „First Movern“. Wir haben als eines der ersten Unternehmen in der Branche die
Weichen auf „E“ wie E-Mobilität gestellt.

##### Digitalisierung

Flexibel und digital. Digital Transformation bei DRÄXLMAIER.

## familie

# Leading materials test laboratory & innovation centre

### UKAS and ISO 17025 accredited (No.0402), helping you overcome complex challenges to get to
### market

[Contact Us][90]

## **Welcome to Impact Solutions**

Impact Solutions is a UKAS-accredited materials testing laboratory and innovation centre based in
Scotland, UK. We help industry solve complex material challenges through independent testing,
analytical chemistry expertise, and accelerated weathering.

Our specialist platforms include Impact-Bio®, which provides biodegradation assessment and
environmental testing expertise, and Impact Innovations, which accelerates product development,
collaborative R&D, grant-funded innovation, and scale-up for new materials, processes, and
technologies.

## UKAS Accredited

Impact Solutions is a leading UKAS and ISO 17025 accredited test laboratory (No. 0402) & innovation
centre.

## Unique Expertise

An independent laboratory with extensive expertise and technical capabilities in polymers and
materials testing.

## Client Focused

Impact Solutions will go the extra mile to meticulously assess your technical challenges and help
solve them.

#### Introducing **Impact-Bio®**

Providing clear guidance and driving real change across the biodegradation landscape to ensure test
methods are fit for purpose and deliver credible, defensible results. 

[Contact us now][91]

## Testing Laboratory

### Impact Solutions is an independent [UKAS][92] accredited laboratory that supports industry in
### testing and developing new materials, products and methods.

[Learn more][93]

Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.
